014382: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_body_mentions_name_outside(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, String8 name, u32 declaration_start, u32 declaration_end)
014383: {
014384:     u32 body_end = builder->body_token_start + builder->body_token_count;
014385:     for (u32 index = builder->body_token_start; index < body_end; index += 1)
014386:     {
014387:         if (index >= declaration_start && index < declaration_end)
014388:         {
014389:             continue;
014390:         }
014391:         CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[index];
014392:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), name))
014393:         {
014394:             return true;
014395:         }
014396:     }
014397:     return false;
014398: }

014413: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_statement_expression_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
014414: {
014415:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
014416:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
014417:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = &machine->frames[machine->frame_count - 1];
014418:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_STATEMENT_EXPRESSION);
014419:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD)
014420:     {
014421:         if (!machine->child_result.success)
014422:         {
014423:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
014424:             return;
014425:         }
014426:         frame->as.statement_expression.value = machine->child_result.value;
014427:         if (frame->as.statement_expression.tail_index)
014428:         {
014429:             frame->as.statement_expression.tail_index -= 1;
014430:             u32 tail_index = frame->as.statement_expression.tail_index;
014431:             CDeclaration declaration = {
014432:                 .name = S8("statement expression"),
014433:                 .location = c_ir_token_location(builder, builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->as.statement_expression.tail_opens[tail_index]]),
014434:                 .body_start = frame->as.statement_expression.tail_starts[tail_index],
014435:                 .body_token_count = frame->as.statement_expression.tail_ends[tail_index] - frame->as.statement_expression.tail_starts[tail_index],
014436:                 .kind = C_DECLARATION_FUNCTION,
014437:             };
014438:             if (!c_ir_lower_body_frame_push(builder, declaration, true))
014439:             {
014440:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
014441:             }
014442:             return;
014443:         }
014444:         IrValueId value = frame->as.statement_expression.value;
014445:         if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
014446:         {
014447:             value = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->as.statement_expression.leaf_open]);
014448:         }
014449:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, value.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID, value);
014450:         return;
014451:     }
014452:     u32 open = frame->as.statement_expression.open;
014453:     u32 close = frame->as.statement_expression.close;
014454:     if (open >= close || !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[open], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE) ||
014455:         !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[close], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE))
014456:     {
014457:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
014458:         return;
014459:     }
014460:     // Empty statement-expression wrappers do not introduce declarations or
014461:     // control-flow state. Descend through them iteratively so generated GNU C
014462:     // with deeply nested `({ ({ ... }); })` expressions cannot consume the C
014463:     // call stack merely to re-enter body lowering.
014464:     while (open + 4 < close)
014465:     {
014466:         u32 nested_start = open + 1;
014467:         u32 nested_end = close;
014468:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[nested_end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_SEMICOLON))
014469:         {
014470:             nested_end -= 1;
014471:         }
014472:         if (nested_start + 3 >= nested_end || !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[nested_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) ||
014473:             !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[nested_start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE) ||
014474:             !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[nested_end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) ||
014475:             c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, nested_start, nested_end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) != nested_end - 1)
014476:         {
014477:             break;
014478:         }
014479:         u32 nested_close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, nested_start + 1, nested_end - 1, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE);
014480:         if (nested_close != nested_end - 2)
014481:         {
014482:             break;
014483:         }
014484:         open = nested_start + 1;
014485:         close = nested_close;
014486:     }
014487:     u32 tail_capacity = (close - open) / 4 + 1;
014488:     frame->as.statement_expression.tail_starts = arena_allocate(builder->scratch_arena, u32, tail_capacity);
014489:     frame->as.statement_expression.tail_ends = arena_allocate(builder->scratch_arena, u32, tail_capacity);
014490:     frame->as.statement_expression.tail_opens = arena_allocate(builder->scratch_arena, u32, tail_capacity);
014491:     frame->as.statement_expression.tail_count = 0;
014492:     while (open + 4 < close && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[open + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
014493:            c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[open + 2], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
014494:     {
014495:         u32 nested_close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, open + 2, close, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE);
014496:         if (nested_close == UINT32_MAX || nested_close + 1 >= close ||
014497:             !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[nested_close + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) ||
014498:             c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, open + 1, close, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) != nested_close + 1)
014499:         {
014500:             break;
014501:         }
014502:         u32 tail_start = nested_close + 2;
014503:         if (tail_start < close && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[tail_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_SEMICOLON))
014504:         {
014505:             tail_start += 1;
014506:         }
014507:         if (tail_start >= close)
014508:         {
014509:             break;
014510:         }
014511:         if (frame->as.statement_expression.tail_count >= tail_capacity)
014512:         {
014513:             builder->failure_message = S8("C statement-expression nesting exceeds the lowering frame capacity");
014514:             builder->failure_token_index = open;
014515:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
014516:             return;
014517:         }
014518:         u32 tail_index = frame->as.statement_expression.tail_count++;
014519:         frame->as.statement_expression.tail_starts[tail_index] = tail_start;
014520:         frame->as.statement_expression.tail_ends[tail_index] = close;
014521:         frame->as.statement_expression.tail_opens[tail_index] = open;
014522:         open += 2;
014523:         close = nested_close;
014524:     }
014525:     frame->as.statement_expression.tail_index = frame->as.statement_expression.tail_count;
014526:     frame->as.statement_expression.leaf_open = open;
014527:     CDeclaration declaration = {
014528:         .name = S8("statement expression"),
014529:         .location = c_ir_token_location(builder, builder->preprocess.tokens[open]),
014530:         .body_start = open + 1,
014531:         .body_token_count = close - open - 1,
014532:         .kind = C_DECLARATION_FUNCTION,
014533:     };
014534:     frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_CHILD;
014535:     if (!c_ir_lower_body_frame_push(builder, declaration, true))
014536:     {
014537:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
014538:     }
014539: }

014552: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constexpr_initializer_valid(IrType* type, IrGlobal* initializer)
014553: {
014554:     if (!type || !initializer)
014555:     {
014556:         return false;
014557:     }
014558:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER)
014559:     {
014560:         return initializer->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO;
014561:     }
014562:     if (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR || type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION)
014563:     {
014564:         return initializer->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_BYTES && initializer->relocation_count == 0;
014565:     }
014566:     return initializer->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_ZERO || initializer->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_INTEGER ||
014567:            initializer->initializer_kind == IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_FLOAT;
014568: }
